[Input from: sm-1966-oc (a1966oc0) via sm send]
Changed crates/sm-server/src/bin/sm.rs: added hidden clap alias request-codex-review -> request-review and deleted the pre-parse rejection that exited 2 on the old name (that rejection was the source of the "fall back to @codex review" path in the ticket). Stale instructions now register the review. Tests: new unit test parses "sm request-codex-review 1808", "... list" through the alias and asserts the alias stays hidden from help; verified it fails without the alias, passes with it. Full sm bin suite: same 9 pre-existing environmental failures as clean tree (sandbox blocks reading ~/.config/session-manager/client.yaml, then poisons the shared env lock); all pass individually. fmt + clippy -D warnings clean. Built binary smoke: "sm request-codex-review --help" exits 0 and prints request-review help. Committed 92da92c7 on 1966-oc-1855; not pushed, no PR, per instructions.

[Input from: sm-1966-oc (a1966oc0) via sm send]
Done with #1966, committed 65d6fa8d on branch 1966-oc-1913 (not pushed, per instructions).

What changed:
- queue.rs spawn_queue_job_process: reused the existing tmux pre-exec descriptor sweep (runtime.rs close_inherited_descriptors_before_exec, now pub(crate)) so a job child closes every non-close-on-exec descriptor above stdio before exec. That removes the inherited 8420 listener and handover.sock seen in job_ab4ea472297f; those arrive non-CLOEXEC when passed over SCM_RIGHTS during blue-green handover, which is why they survived the exec chain into test children.
- New test queue::tests::queue_job_child_inherits_no_descriptors_above_stdio binds a unix listener in the test process, clears its CLOEXEC flag to mirror the live runner, then spawns a real queue job whose shell snapshots its own open descriptors with lsof. Fails before the fix (child shows probe.sock at fd 3), passes after.
- http.rs direct-harness lsof assertion tightened: it only failed on REG/DIR leaks, so an inherited socket slipped through. It now fails on any production-root entry or any (LISTEN) entry. Verified the tightened check still passes standalone.

Testing: scripts/test-rust-isolated.sh full lib suite = 1171 passed, 3 failed (config::test_isolation_retains_safe_fixtures_and_rejects_production_paths and two real_tmux tests) — confirmed pre-existing on a clean checkout, sandbox permission denials. cargo fmt and cargo clippy -D warnings clean.
